examples.description: Use footage from one second later in the same clip

description: Show a different part of a clip's or scene's footage without moving it: its in and out points move by delta_ms of timeline (positive shows later footage), while its position and length stay. Works on video and audio clips and on scenes with finished video. Refuses, naming the fix: an unknown id, text or a still image or a scene with no footage yet (only video and audio can slip), a locked track, or a delta that runs past the footage (the refusal gives the delta_ms range that fits).

clip_id.description: A video or audio clip (vcl_) or a scene (vs_) with finished video.

delta_ms.description: Milliseconds to move the footage window; positive shows later footage.

project_id.description: The studio project (vp_…) this tool acts on.
